title: AI-based detection of MRI-invisible prostate cancer with nnU-Net.
summary: Primary full text reports nnU-Net analysis of 1,475 mpMRI images for MRI-invisible prostate cancer, with five-fold CV. The high false-negative rate is a material limitation.
ai_technology: nnU-Net adaptive image-recognition system applied to mpMRI; five-fold cross-validation.

evidence.tested: Internal CV only; no clinical benefit established; preserve the false-negative limitation.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: nnU-Net adaptive image-recognition system applied to mpMRI; five-fold cross-validation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
